daily.title: Warning issued for 'dangerous, fast-moving' fire burning near Gladstone
daily.summary: Twelve crews are working to control the blaze burning near Kirkwood Road, near Gladstone, and aerial support has been requested.

daily.title: Morley Market business owners still struggling one year after devastating fire
daily.summary: One year on from a devastating fire which destroyed a shopping centre in Perth's north-east, the pain for business owners who lost what they had spent years working on is still raw.

daily.title: Teen granted bail in Brisbane alleged carjacking murder
daily.summary: The 15-year-old was initially charged with a range of offences including robbery in company and grievous bodily harm, but this was upgraded to murder after the man died in August.

daily.title: Nepal's peak trekking season is approaching but its guides are in mourning
daily.summary: For many of Nepal's trekking guides, who lead tourists through the Himalayas, there is something heavier to carry into the mountains this year: their grief.

daily.title: Pipeline companies' major plans to supply east coast with Beetaloo gas
daily.summary: Gas is flowing from the Beetaloo Basin to Darwin, and two companies are progressing plans to connect the resource to homes and businesses in the eastern states.

daily.title: US declares it will accelerate military presence in Australia
daily.summary: Defence Minister Richard Marles has met with his US counterpart in Washington DC to discuss an expansion of the US military presence at Australian military bases.

daily.title: France's world-first fast fashion laws take hit Shein and Temu with new fees
daily.summary: Brands like Shein and Temu which list millions of garment products on their websites will be hit hard by a fee on items for French consumers.

daily.title: Australia pushes for condemnation of China’s missile test
daily.summary: Australia and Palau want to issue a formal condemnation of China's missile test in the Pacific in July, but not all countries in the region agree.

daily.title: Concerns over power station fire on Tasmania's power network
daily.summary: An overnight fire that gutted one of Tasmania's hydro power stations raises questions about the effect it will have on the state's power network.

daily.title: Boyd 'extremely honoured' after signing two-year deal as Maroons coach
daily.summary: Former Maroons Origin mainstay Darius Boyd is named as Queensland's successor to Billy Slater.

daily.title: Cox says Swans five will remain banned regardless of police probe result
daily.summary: Sydney's coach says there is no way any of the five players stood down will come back to partake in this year's finals campaign.

daily.title: Alice Springs baby dies after mother forced to live with DV perpetrators
daily.summary: A six-week-old Aboriginal baby died after her mother was evicted and forced to sleep on the floor of an overcrowded house with people who had previously assaulted her, a coroner has found.

daily.title: John Setka launches tirade against CFMEU administrators outside court
daily.summary: The former union boss spoke to reporters after facing a Melbourne court charged with using a telecommunications device to menace and offend.

daily.title: Qantas slashes allowance and raises luggage prices for island flights
daily.summary: Qantas has slashed luggage allowances to Australia's most remote territories. Locals say the airline is reducing access to essential supplies.

daily.title: Government offers small businesses a trust tax workaround
daily.summary: Those with discretionary trusts can be exempt from the new minimum 30 per cent tax if they agree to hold their trust distributions constant.

daily.title: Season uncertainty 'challenging' for AFLW community
daily.summary: Key AFLW stakeholders say they would like to see more certainty about their fixture and important dates, which they say would help with performance and getting more fans to games.

daily.title: Victims of crime numbers have fallen by about 4pc under the LNP
daily.summary: The Crisafulli government says the drop of more than 12,000 recorded victims of crime are "green shoots" in their crime crackdown.

daily.title: Debt-ridden developer Bathla will meet its payroll obligations
daily.summary: The embattled Bathla Group has found some funding to pay its staff today as it teeters on collapse.

daily.title: Australia deploys drones to Nepal as death toll passes 1,200
daily.summary: Australia ramps up its humanitarian aid and deploys drone specialists to Nepal as the death toll passes a tragic milestone.

daily.title: Fire rips through distinctive Queensland highway hotel
daily.summary: Fire has engulfed Falvey's Sundowner Saloon on the Warrego Highway west of Brisbane, with emergency crews responding to the blaze.

daily.title: Man charged over alleged social media threat against federal minister
daily.summary: A NSW Snowy Mountains man has been granted bail after allegedly threatening Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek on social media.

daily.title: As Animalia turns 40, its author reflects on its extraordinary success
daily.summary: Graeme Base's lavishly illustrated alliterative alphabet book has captured the imaginations of generations of children around the world since it was published four decades ago.

daily.title: Sydney Uni challenges $80k council fee for $5.6m kitchen renovation
daily.summary: City of Sydney councillors deferred the application by the University of Sydney to the office of the NSW planning minister on Wednesday evening over the $80,470 dispute.

daily.title: Victorian town left without childcare service for two years calls for help
daily.summary: A Victorian council is calling on the state government to immediately act to solve an early years facility crisis that has left local families without child care for two years.

daily.title: Fagan lashes Kangaroos over 'unfair' comments after Clarkson axing
daily.summary: Brisbane coach Chris Fagan reveals his shock at seeing his old friend Alastair Clarkson sacked by North Melbourne.

developing.title: Live: ASX falls sharply, oil hits two-month high amid US-Iran strikes
developing.summary: The Australian share market is recording heavy losses after the US launched fresh strikes against Iran, driving oil prices up and contributing to a global bond sell-off. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Four more Australians confirmed safe in Nepal-Tibet flood disaster
developing.summary: Four more Australians have been confirmed safe after the Nepal-Tibet flood, with the number of unaccounted-for Australians revised down to 38. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Iran says US will 'regret' new wave of attacks
developing.summary: The new round of strikes comes after Iran attempted to attack American troops and commercial ships in the region, according to US central command. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Hadley sent text message saying Jones 'needs to be destroyed', court told
developing.summary: Retired 2GB radio host Ray Hadley has resumed giving evidence at Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial.

developing.title: Live: Hadley back in the witness box for a third day, as Jones trial resumes
developing.summary: Ray Hadley returns for a third day to Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial, which has been examining the pair's "tumultuous" relationship.

developing.title: Live: ASX to open higher after sea of green on Wall Street
developing.summary: The ASX is set to open higher after gains on Wall Street. The price of oil is above $US95/barrel as the bond market steadies. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Opposition leader says teachers running 'political agendas' in schools
developing.summary: Angus Taylor would not say whether he agreed with comments from Nationals leader Matt Canavan that there needed to be more male teachers in classrooms. Follow live.
